claim: Score model JSON outside the model with a strict validator (actual types, exact key set, enums, no duplicate keys, no nonstandard constants, no fences): dict equality accepts 0 for false. A malformed or non-conforming answer is unusable advice, and an unknown outcome after a request was written is held for reconciliation, never auto-retried.

decisions.notes: Mac controller errata 2026-11-10 and the Windows design review of cline_autoresearcher.py, whose Tier-2 retry after any failure violated this rule.
